description: Polygon feature class of Miami-Dade County, Public Schools attendance zones for Elementary schools (PK-5) and K-8 Centers (PK-8) schools. K-8 Centers are elementary schools that have middle school grades.
copyright: Data was provided by staff of DCPS, Marta Leyva, Associate Superintendent of School Operations. Judy Catteray, DCPS reviewed the boundaries and addressed any concerns to the Board.  Boundaries were drawn using the "Attendance Zones Previously Approved By The Board 2001 - 2002" also, referred to as the Legals, was provided by the Board.  Miami-Dade County Public Schools, Schools Operations, Final Reading - May 15, 2003 Board Rule 6Gx13-5A1.10.
